study_design: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled cancer prevention trial
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 974 men with a history of either a basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma were randomized to either a daily supplement of 200 microg of selenium or a placebo.
reason: The trial reports incident prostate cancer as a secondary endpoint without defining or analyzing aggressive incident prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There were 13 prostate cancer cases in the selenium-treated group and 35 cases in the placebo group (relative risk, RR=0.37, P=0.002).
estimate_classifications.reason: The selenium-versus-placebo estimate is for overall prostate cancer incidence, with no aggressive subtype specified.
